meta_description: JK Emergency Locksmith Leicester. Fast lockout response, lock repairs & replacements. Available 24/7. Call 07501 793857 now.
hero_subhead: Stuck outside your home or business at 2am? JK Emergency Locksmith reaches you fast, any time, any day.
services_subhead: From emergency lockouts to lock replacements and repairs, we handle every locksmith job with speed and skill.

services.title: Emergency Lockouts
services.desc: Locked out of your home, car, or office? We arrive quickly and open your door without damage, 24 hours a day.

services.title: Lock Repairs & Replacements
services.desc: Broken locks, worn cylinders, or stuck mechanisms. We repair or replace with quality hardware that lasts.

services.title: New Locks Fitted
services.desc: Upgrading your security? We install modern mortice locks, multipoint locks, and euro cylinders to fit your needs.

services.title: uPVC Door Locks
services.desc: Specialist in uPVC and composite door locks. We fit, repair, and adjust mechanisms to stop rattling and improve security.

services.title: Burglary Repairs
services.desc: Damaged locks after a break-in? We repair or replace damaged doors and locks the same day to restore your home's security.

services.title: Commercial Lock Services
services.desc: Offices, shops, and warehouses need reliable security. We service and install commercial locks and access control systems.

about_pullquote: I started this business because homeowners deserve fast, honest help when they're locked out.
about_para_1: JK Emergency Locksmith has been serving Leicester for over 10 years. Founded on the principle that a lockout shouldn't mean a two-hour wait or an inflated bill, we built a reputation for turning up fast and getting the job done right.
about_para_2: Our customers trust us because we're local, we're available around the clock, and we price fairly — no hidden charges, no surprises. Whether it's a family home in Braunstone or a shop on Belgrave Road, we treat every job with the same care and professionalism.
reviews_heading: What Leicester Customers Say About Us

reviews.text: Locked myself out on a Sunday evening with my kids inside. JK arrived in 20 minutes and had us back in without any fuss. Fantastic service and a fair price. Saved the day.
reviews.author: Michael T.

reviews.text: Called at 1am after a break-in. They came out within the hour and fitted new locks. Professional, quick, and the price was reasonable considering the time. Really impressed.
reviews.author: Jennifer P.

reviews.text: Had issues with my uPVC door lock jamming constantly. JK fixed it properly and explained what was wrong. Won't go to anyone else now. Best locksmith in Leicester.
reviews.author: David M.
